subject: general
question: Chutka Atomic Power Plant is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chutka Nuclear Power Plant is a nuclear power plant built on a 1,200 acres (490 ha) area, near the Chutka Village of Mandla district in Madhya Pradesh. 
 
• The site is near Kanha National Park, one of the tiger reserves of India and the largest national park of Madhya Pradesh state in India.
 
• The project will have an installed capacity of 1400 Megawatts.
 
• It was built by the Nuclear Power Corporation of India, the project is estimated to cost ₹ 17,000 Crore (US$ 2.56 billion) as of January 2014.
